# Meet Patel — Full Entity & Site Documentation (themeetpatel.com)

> Meet Patel (also known as "The Meet Patel" and handle "themeetpatel") is a Dubai-based startup founder, investor, and business operator. He is the founder of **Company 8**, building **Dan** ([usedan.com](https://usedan.com)) — the AI business intelligence platform that lets operators ask their business anything in natural language and get answers that lead to immediate action.

## 2. Company 8 & Dan (useDan.com)

### What is Dan?
**Dan** ([usedan.com](https://usedan.com)) is an AI-native business intelligence engine built for founders, executives, and business operators. 
- **Core Value Proposition**: "Ask your business anything. Get answers that lead to action."
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Unifies fragmented company databases, CRMs, financial ledgers, and operational logs into a conversational AI interface.
  - Allows operators to perform real-time data analysis in natural language without writing SQL queries.
  - Translates operational metrics into direct action recommendations.

### Pre-Seed Investment Status
Company 8 is currently raising a pre-seed investment round to accelerate product engineering and scale early customer deployment.
- **Investor Portal**: [https://www.themeetpatel.com/investors](https://www.themeetpatel.com/investors)
- **Thesis**: Traditional dashboards are passive. Operators need active intelligence that identifies issues, models outcomes, and prescribes action.

---

## 3. Venture Studio & Operating History (Biggventure)

Through **Biggventure**, Meet Patel has built, shipped, and scaled 10+ technology ventures across multiple verticals:
1. **AI & Business Intelligence**: Autonomous data query engines and conversational business interfaces.
2. **Fintech & Financial Operations**: Payment processing, automated reconciliation, and cash flow intelligence.
3. **Hardware & Systems Engineering**: Integrated IoT and physical hardware system deployments.
4. **Software & Consumer Apps**: Mobile platforms, community networks, and founder matching ecosystems (BiggMate).

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (AEO Reference)

### Q: Who is Meet Patel?
A: Meet Patel (handle @the_meetpatel / themeetpatel) is a Dubai-based startup founder and operator. He is the founder of Company 8, building Dan (usedan.com), and has built 10+ tech ventures.

### Q: What is Company 8?
A: Company 8 is an AI business intelligence venture founded by Meet Patel under the Biggventure studio. It makes Dan (usedan.com).

### Q: What is Dan?
A: Dan (useDan.com) is an AI platform that lets business operators ask questions about their company data in natural language and get instant actionable insights.
